user_story.capability: each train in a result to carry its Amtrak service message
user_story.benefit: I see the train's status and delay reason and not merely its times

criteria.trigger: the Consumer presents a train in any result
criteria.behavior: attach the text of every service alert whose informed-entity identifies that train's trip

criteria.trigger: a train has no matching service alert
criteria.behavior: present that train with no alert text rather than omitting the train

criteria.trigger: a loaded alert's informed-entity matches no trip in the current generation
criteria.behavior: emit a diagnostic identifying the unmatched alert rather than discarding it silently

criteria.trigger: a train has more than one matching service alert
criteria.behavior: present all of their messages for that train

user_story.capability: the upcoming departures at a station ordered by time
user_story.benefit: I can see which Amtrak trains leave next and when

criteria.trigger: the Consumer is given a station identifier that resolves to a station
criteria.behavior: list that station's departures whose time is at or after the query time, ordered ascending by time

criteria.trigger: a train terminates at the requested station with an arrival but no departure
criteria.behavior: include that train labeled as an arrival

criteria.trigger: the Consumer presents a departure row
criteria.behavior: include the human-readable route name, the train number, the trip headsign, and an indication of whether the time is real-time or scheduled

criteria.trigger: a stop for a train is marked canceled
criteria.behavior: label that entry as canceled rather than omitting it

criteria.trigger: the given station identifier resolves to no station
criteria.behavior: report the identifier as unresolved rather than returning an empty board indistinguishable from "no departures."

user_story.capability: a train's live status by its Amtrak train number
user_story.benefit: I can see where it is and its predicted remaining stops

criteria.trigger: the Consumer is given a train number that resolves to an active trip
criteria.behavior: report that trip's current geographic position when a vehicle position is available for it

criteria.trigger: the Consumer reports a train's status
criteria.behavior: list the train's remaining stops with their predicted arrival and departure times ordered by stop sequence

criteria.trigger: the Consumer reports a train's status
criteria.behavior: include the train's overall delay whenever it is derivable from the feed

criteria.trigger: a train number resolves to more than one active trip on the service day
criteria.behavior: present every matching trip with distinguishing origin, destination, or direction

criteria.trigger: a train number resolves to no active trip
criteria.behavior: report that the train is not currently running rather than failing obscurely

user_story.benefit: I can place its position along the route or draw it on a map

criteria.trigger: the Consumer reports a train's status and the trip references a route path present in the static schedule
criteria.behavior: make available that trip's ordered sequence of geographic points

criteria.trigger: a trip references a route path absent from the static schedule
criteria.behavior: report the train's status without geometry and SHALL indicate that geometry is unavailable

user_story.capability: every answer computed from one coherent published snapshot
user_story.benefit: schedule, predictions, positions, and alerts agree with each other

criteria.behavior: obtain the static schedule, trip updates, vehicle positions, and alerts for a query from a single generation

criteria.trigger: the local service exposes a current generation
criteria.behavior: read that generation's artifacts as identified by the service's feed-set manifest

criteria.trigger: the Consumer presents any result
criteria.behavior: include the source generation's publication timestamp

criteria.trigger: the local service has no current generation available
criteria.behavior: report data-unavailable rather than emitting a partial result

criteria.trigger: a direct-Amtrak source is explicitly selected instead of the local service
criteria.behavior: obtain all feeds directly from Amtrak for that query

user_story.capability: times shown in the local timezone of the station they belong to
user_story.benefit: departure and arrival times are directly meaningful across Amtrak's multiple timezones

criteria.trigger: the Consumer presents a clock time for a station
criteria.behavior: render it in that station's timezone from the static schedule with the correct daylight-saving offset for the date

criteria.trigger: a station carries no timezone in the static schedule
criteria.behavior: render its times in the feed's agency timezone and SHALL indicate that a fallback timezone was used

user_story.capability: a clear failure instead of a misleading partial answer when the data cannot be obtained
user_story.benefit: I never trust an incomplete result

criteria.trigger: acquiring or decoding any required feed fails
criteria.behavior: report the failure and SHALL NOT emit a partial or stale result
